name: Nacho Tumbleweed Jr.
source:
Nacho Tumbleweed Jr. is Rad Shiba's boss. At some point before the events of the game, Nacho founded the Canine Independent Rescue Association (CIRA for short). 

He graduated top of his class at hand-to-paw combat due to being the only one who watched the instruction video.
translation:
Nacho Tumbleweed Jr. is Rad Shiba's boss. At some point before the events of the game, Nacho founded the Canine Independent Rescue Association (CIRA for short). 

He graduated top of his class at hand-to-paw combat due to being the only one who watched the instruction video.
